about.title: About me
about.paragraph_1: My beginnings in programming date back to 2021, in the midst of the pandemic and during my school years. It was in programming that I took my first steps, starting with Gobstones, a simple language composed of instructions like move, remove, put, and repeat. Although those first steps felt unreal, they were the starting point.
about.paragraph_2: It wasn't until the following year that I discovered web programming. Suddenly, I was like a fish in an immense ocean: constantly learning, searching, asking questions, and solving problems. It was during this time that I discovered what would become my first technology stack: MEVN. This set of technologies became my foundation for developing school projects and gave me the tools to begin creating more complex solutions.
about.paragraph_3: In my final year of school, I completed several projects using MEVN, but I also experimented with PHP, expanding my knowledge and exploring different approaches to web development. However, I felt like something was missing. I began to wonder what other tools might offer me more advantages when starting a project. That's when I discovered WordPress, a platform that not only allowed me to create code-free solutions but also offered great SEO potential.
about.paragraph_4: With this technology, I finally decided to jump into the freelance world. Projects started coming in, and with them, the opportunity to hone my skills. These projects not only allowed me to strengthen my knowledge but also led me to develop more interactive and user-focused interfaces.
about.paragraph_5: In every experience, I see an opportunity to push the boundaries of what web development can achieve, while always keeping the focus on the user experience.
about.paragraph_6: In my free time, I like to design interfaces for fun, test new technologies, and continue honing my skills. Because, at the end of the day, every line of code is an opportunity to express creativity and solve problems in impactful ways.
